{{Short description|South American football tournament stage}}
The '''2024 Copa Sudamericana first stage''' was played from 5 to 7 March 2024.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://cdn.conmebol.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/Calendario-2024_aprobado-Consejo-10-07-2023-1.pdf|title=CALENDÁRIO 2024: CONMEBOL Libertadores - CONMEBOL Sudamericana - RECOPA|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=10 July 2023|access-date=30 November 2023}}</ref> A total of 32 teams competed in the first stage to decide 16 of the 32 places in the [[2024 Copa Sudamericana group stage|group stage]] of the [[2024 Copa Sudamericana]].<ref name="regulations">{{cite web|url=https://cdn.conmebol.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/12/Manual-de-Clubes-CS-2024-ESP-Digital.pdf|title=Manual de Clubes CONMEBOL Sudamericana 2024|publisher=CONMEBOL|date=13 December 2023|access-date=18 December 2023}}</ref>

==Draw==
<section begin=Draw />
The draw for the first stage was held on 19 December 2023, 12:00 [[Time in Paraguay|PYST]] ([[UTC−03:00|UTC−3]]), at the CONMEBOL Convention Centre in [[Luque]], [[Paraguay]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.directvsports.com/futbol/Cuando-es-el-sorteo-de-la-Copa-CONMEBOL-Libertadores-2024-y-la-Copa-CONMEBOL-Sudamericana-2024-20231212-0007.html|title=Cuándo es el sorteo de la Copa CONMEBOL Libertadores 2024 y la Copa CONMEBOL Sudamericana 2024|trans-title=When is the draw for the 2024 Copa CONMEBOL Libertadores and Copa CONMEBOL Sudamericana|publisher=DSports|date=11 December 2023|access-date=18 December 2023|language=es}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/noticias/enfrentamientos-en-la-fase-preliminar-de-la-conmebol-sudamericana-2024/|title=Enfrentamientos en la Fase Preliminar de la CONMEBOL Sudamericana 2024|trans-title=Matchups in the Preliminary Stage of the 2024 CONMEBOL Sudamericana|publisher=CONMEBOL|date=19 December 2023|access-date=20 December 2023|language=es}}</ref>

For the first stage, the 32 teams involved were divided into eight pots according to their national association. The 32 teams were drawn into 16 ties, with the four teams from each national association being drawn against a rival from the same association in two ties per association.<ref name="draw procedure">{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/noticias/pautas-de-sorteo-para-la-conmebol-libertadores-y-sudamericana-2024/|title=Pautas de sorteo para la CONMEBOL Libertadores y Sudamericana 2024|trans-title=Draw guidelines for the 2024 CONMEBOL Libertadores and Sudamericana|publisher=CONMEBOL|date=12 December 2023|access-date=18 December 2023|language=es}}</ref><section end=Draw />

==Format==
<section begin=Format />
In the first stage, each tie was played on a [[Single-elimination tournament|single-leg]] basis, with the winner being decided in a [[penalty shoot-out]] in case of a draw after 90 minutes.<ref name="regulations"/>

The 16 winners of the first stage advanced to the [[2024 Copa Sudamericana group stage|group stage]] to join the 12 teams directly qualified for that stage (six from Argentina and six from Brazil), and four teams transferred from the [[2024 Copa Libertadores|Copa Libertadores]] (the four teams eliminated in the [[2024 Copa Libertadores qualifying stages#Third stage|third stage]] of [[2024 Copa Libertadores qualifying stages|qualifying]]).<section end=Format />

==Matches==
